authority_fields.authority_id: Stable id of the expected-margin authority.
authority_fields.hfa_points: Home-field advantage in points, on the same axis.
authority_fields.hfa_treatment: How venue maps onto the HFA term.
authority_fields.point_axis_id: The declared point axis. The disputed resolution lives here.
authority_fields.status: GOVERNED, or a non-promoting fixture class.

fail_closed.fixture_authority: Refused for any run whose results could be cited.

per_observation_fields.actual_margin: Final scoring margin from the subject team's perspective.
per_observation_fields.event_time: ISO-8601 kickoff instant. The chronological key. It, not week, is what orders two games inside one week and what proves a prediction preceded its outcome.
per_observation_fields.game_id: Stable unique key. Deduplication and split assignment key.
per_observation_fields.governed_expected_margin: The authority's own pregame predicted margin for this game. Required, and never defaulted: see the module docstring.
per_observation_fields.pregame_opponent_points: Opponent's pregame point strength on the same axis.
per_observation_fields.pregame_team_points: Subject team's point strength BEFORE kickoff, on the authority's declared axis. Used as the season opening strength on a team's first appearance and as the transform cross-check thereafter.
per_observation_fields.provenance: Named origin of the row, carried through to the shard table.
per_observation_fields.season: Season the game belongs to. State is re-initialised per season.
per_observation_fields.split: One of ['training', 'validation', 'holdout']. Assigned in the corpus, temporally.
per_observation_fields.venue: One of ['HOME', 'AWAY', 'NEUTRAL'], from the subject team's perspective.
per_observation_fields.week: Week PLAYED. Establishes which rerating boundary the game sits behind.

separations.expected_margin_vs_prediction: governed_expected_margin is the authority's number and is corpus data. The candidate's own evolving prediction is derived state and is what the primary objective scores.
separations.raw_vs_derived: ObservationRow is frozen and is never written to. All model state lives in TeamCalibrationState.

game_sd_points.estimated_on: validation or holdout residuals; the training split is refused
game_sd_points.reason: Selection is on RMSE, which needs no dispersion parameter, so the estimate cannot change which candidate wins. SD of actual margin measures the sport's variability rather than the model's error.

identification_defects: movement cap did not bind, so its value is not identified
depth optimum sat on the search boundary, so it is not identified
corpus provenance does not satisfy the current admission contract

identification_reporting.policy: A cap that never binds is not identified and is never reported as a finding. Where candidates tie on the primary metric and differ only in a family the corpus cannot see, the aggregate reports an equivalence class rather than a discovery.

objective.witness_reporting: Colley and SRS are computed from outcomes alone and are candidate-independent. Each candidate reports a Spearman rank correlation against them as a coherence witness. Neither is converted onto the V3 point axis and neither enters the ranking.

operator_interface.fan_out: Run score_one_shard once per shard index with the same --shard-count and the same --expect-config-sha. Membership is candidate_id % shard_count, so the workers need no coordination and cannot overlap.

parameter_families.separation_reason: game_sd_points is a property of the residuals a mean model leaves behind. Enumerating it as an axis would let a candidate choose the dispersion its own errors are scored against.

policy.excluded_from_ranking: Rows whose failure_status is not OK.

tie_breaks.reason: A second error measure on the same residuals, less dominated by the handful of blowouts that move RMSE.

Among equally accurate models, prefer the one whose weekly ratings move less. A rating that swings to reach the same accuracy is worse to publish, and this is the diagnostic ruling R2-CAL-OBJECTIVE already names.
Terminal and total, so the order is fully determined. Reaching this tie-break means the corpus did not separate the candidates, which the equivalence-class report states rather than hides.

blocking_inputs.reason: BLOCKED_ON_CALIBRATION_DATA: no historical observation set is mounted, and none was supplied.
blocking_inputs.supplied_as: An exact dataset SHA-256, registered through calibration_evidence.register_governed_dataset.

blocking_inputs.reason: No expected-margin authority supplied. Scoring is refused rather than run against a default transform: the historical point-axis resolution is the disputed question, and inventing one here would answer it by accident.
blocking_inputs.required_for: Converting point strengths into a predicted margin.
blocking_inputs.supplied_as: An ExpectedMarginAuthority with status GOVERNED, naming its point axis and rating-to-margin transform.

blocking_inputs.reason: Search space V3-CAL-SEARCH-COARSE-001 carries no range authority. Its axes are RANGE_PENDING_EVIDENCE: the levels are scaffolding chosen to exercise the harness, not ranges any evidence supports. A real search requires a named authority that fixes them.
blocking_inputs.required_for: Turning the pending coarse axes into fixed ranges.
blocking_inputs.supplied_as: A named ruling that fixes each axis, flipping its evidence status to RANGE_FIXED_BY_NAMED_AUTHORITY.

scope: Deterministic candidate universe, temporal walk-forward scorer, shard protocol and aggregator for the six V3 calibration families. No parameter is selected, promoted, or written to canonical configuration.

coarse.precision_policy: Deliberately coarse. Resolving a third decimal place here costs the same compute as covering twice the space, and Stage 2 resolves it anyway over a region Stage 1 has already justified.
coarse.purpose: Locate useful regions of the parameter space.
coarse.universe: Cross product of the five mean-model families.

holdout.custody: calibration_search.HoldoutLedger records the single consumption and refuses a second. Iterative tuning against the holdout is not discouraged; it is unavailable.
holdout.dispersion_policy: game_sd_points is carried in from validation rather than re-estimated here, so the holdout does not inform its own diagnostics.
holdout.purpose: Score a shortlist once against a split nothing has touched.
holdout.universe: An explicit shortlist, capped at 8 candidates.

refinement.boundary_policy: A family whose leader sat on an edge of an expandable ladder is extended one full step past it. The search grows rather than reporting the edge.
refinement.purpose: Resolve the leading regions, and widen any that hit a boundary.
refinement.universe: A pure function of the coarse space and the ordered Stage-1 leaders, so two operators build byte-identical Stage-2 universes.
